notes: Machine-readable catalogue of the effect library. Human reference: docs/effects.md.
Two closed lists: `effects` (12 sticker effects, each on one sticker) and `canvasEffects` (canvas effects: weather and light over the whole scene, each suited to one or more pack settings).
A Kit test asserts this file matches the compiled library (EffectDefinition.library, CanvasEffectDefinition.library); edit both together.
Story tooling should read this file to learn which effects exist, what they mean, which parameters each accepts, and which canvas effects suit a pack's setting.

effect.description: One of the effect names below.

sticker.description: Sticker ID from the pack manifest. Every placed instance of it is affected; if none is placed the trigger silently does not fire.

at.description: Seconds into this language's narration at which the effect starts.

cue.description: Authoring label only (e.g. the word it lines up with). Never interpreted by the app.

repeat.description: Cycles to run; "loop" runs until playback ends. Ignored by one-way effects.

duration.description: Seconds for ONE cycle. Total run time is duration × repeat.

intensity.description: Amplitude, never speed. 0 is visually identical to no effect.

color.description: Read by glow, tint and sparkle only. Required by tint.

hold.description: Keep the end state until playback ends. Meaningful for fade-in, fade-out, glow, tint only.

effect.description: One of the canvas effect names below. A canvas trigger has no sticker.

at.description: Seconds into this language's narration at which the effect starts building up.

cue.description: Authoring label only. Never interpreted by the app.

intensity.description: How strong: denser fog, heavier rain, darker dimlight or night. 0 is visually identical to no effect.

duration.description: Seconds the effect stays on, ramps included. There is no repeat, colour or hold.

effects.name: pulse
effects.summary: One gentle size beat. The universal "look at this one".
effects.use: Draw attention to the sticker being talked about.

effects.name: wobble
effects.summary: Tilts side to side around its base. The default "this thing is reacting".
effects.use: Reactions: surprise, laughter, a sneeze, being bumped.

effects.name: shake
effects.summary: Fast, small horizontal tremble. Fear, cold, excitement.

effects.name: hop
effects.summary: One small arc up and back down. The most charming one in the list.
effects.use: Joy, a jump, saying hello, a heartbeat of excitement. repeat 2–3 for bouncing.

effects.name: spin
effects.summary: One full clockwise rotation about the centre.
effects.use: Twirling, dizziness, a pirouette, a tumble. Intensity does not change the turn (only 0 disables it).

effects.name: float
effects.summary: Very slow vertical bob. Built for loop.
effects.use: Anything airborne or afloat: butterflies, bees, birds, clouds, boats. Use repeat "loop". The only scenery loop in the library: trees and flowers stay still.

effects.name: fade-in
effects.use: Arrivals, waking up, being noticed. Pair with sparkle for a magical entrance.

effects.name: fade-out
effects.use: Leaving, hiding, falling asleep. hold true keeps the sticker gone until the story ends; otherwise it fades back in.

effects.name: glow
effects.summary: A soft bloom rises around the sticker and falls away. Reads as magic.
effects.use: Magic, warmth, a wish, the sun coming out. hold true keeps the bloom on.

effects.name: tint
effects.summary: A colour washes over the sticker and drains away. White + short duration = a flash.
effects.use: Blushing (pink), cold (blue), angry (red), a camera flash (white, duration 0.2). color is required.

effects.name: sparkle
effects.summary: A small shower of twinkles above the sticker. The generic magic/delight beat.
effects.use: Delight, magic, treasure, a good idea.

effects.name: hearts
effects.summary: A few hearts drift up. Affection, a hug, a friend.

canvasEffects.name: fog
canvasEffects.summary: Soft mist drifts slowly across the whole scene.
canvasEffects.use: Early morning, a mystery, something hidden then found, quiet and hush. Builds up slowly, so cue it a beat early.

canvasEffects.name: rain
canvasEffects.summary: Rain falls over everything; the light cools a little.
canvasEffects.use: Rain in the story: pitter-patter, puddles, sheltering under a cap. Intensity is drizzle to downpour.

canvasEffects.name: sunshine
canvasEffects.summary: Warm light across the top of the scene, soft shafts drifting down.
canvasEffects.use: The sun comes out, a warm afternoon, waking up, a happy ending after rain.

canvasEffects.name: rainbow
canvasEffects.summary: A soft rainbow arcs across the sky behind the scenery.
canvasEffects.use: The reward after rain, a wish come true, a wonder everyone looks up at. One per story at most.

canvasEffects.name: night
canvasEffects.summary: Night falls: the scene darkens and a moon glows in the sky.
canvasEffects.use: Evening and bedtime outdoors, the moon coming up, stars, a story that settles to sleep. Never darkness as a threat. Builds slowly, so cue it a beat early.

canvasEffects.name: snow
canvasEffects.summary: Soft snowflakes drift down over everything; the light turns cool and bright.
canvasEffects.use: Winter, a snow day, the first flakes, a quiet hush. Intensity is a few flakes to a thick flurry.

canvasEffects.name: sunset
canvasEffects.summary: A warm orange-pink glow spreads from the horizon while the sky above deepens.
canvasEffects.use: The end of the day, going home, a calm golden moment. Followed by night it makes a gentle bedtime. Builds slowly, so cue it a beat early.

canvasEffects.name: clouds
canvasEffects.summary: Big soft clouds drift slowly across the sky behind the scenery; the light dims a little.
canvasEffects.use: A cloudy day, a cloud shaped like something, the grey before rain, the sun going in.

canvasEffects.name: wind
canvasEffects.summary: Pale wisps of air sweep across the scene with a few specks tumbling along.
canvasEffects.use: A windy day, a kite, a hat or a leaf blown away, a whoosh. Intensity is a breeze to a gust.

canvasEffects.name: fireflies
canvasEffects.summary: Tiny warm lights drift and glow softly, mostly low over the ground.
canvasEffects.use: A summer evening, a little magic in the dark, lighting the way. Lovely over night or sunset.

canvasEffects.name: leaves
canvasEffects.summary: Autumn leaves flutter down and drift sideways across the scene.
canvasEffects.use: Autumn, a gust shaking the trees, change, a leaf pile. Only for packs with trees.

canvasEffects.name: dimlight
canvasEffects.summary: The lights go low: the scene darkens toward its edges.
canvasEffects.use: Bedtime, a lamp switched low, a cosy evening, a whispered secret. Never darkness as a threat.

canvasEffects.name: windowlight
canvasEffects.summary: A slanted shaft of sunlight falls across the room, with dust motes turning in it.
canvasEffects.use: Morning, waking up, a lazy sunny afternoon, the sun coming out while everyone is inside.

canvasEffects.name: firelight
canvasEffects.summary: A warm glow from below flickers slowly and gently while the room around it dims.
canvasEffects.use: A fireplace, birthday candles, a cosy evening, telling stories together. Never a fire as danger.

canvasEffects.name: rainywindow
canvasEffects.summary: The room turns cool and grey while raindrops trickle down, as if seen through glass.
canvasEffects.use: A rainy day indoors, waiting for the rain to stop, a quiet day inside.

canvasEffects.name: confetti
canvasEffects.summary: A shower of colourful confetti flutters down over the whole scene.
canvasEffects.use: A birthday, a party, a hooray, a happy ending. One per story at most.

canvasEffects.name: bubbles
canvasEffects.summary: Bubbles float up and wobble gently over the scene.
canvasEffects.use: Bath time, washing up, blowing bubbles, a party; under the sea, a fish talking or something bubbling up.

canvasEffects.name: shootingstars
canvasEffects.summary: Now and then a shooting star streaks across the sky.
canvasEffects.use: Making a wish, wonder, look! Intensity is a single one now and then to a meteor shower.

canvasEffects.name: nebula
canvasEffects.summary: Soft purple and teal clouds of light swell across the sky behind the scenery.
canvasEffects.use: A magical place, wonder, drifting far from home, a dreamy moment. Builds slowly, so cue it a beat early.

canvasEffects.name: warp
canvasEffects.summary: Stars stretch into streaks rushing out from the centre: zooming through space.
canvasEffects.use: Blast-off, zooming to a new planet, whoosh. Short: a few seconds is plenty.

canvasEffects.name: planetrise
canvasEffects.summary: A big glowing planet rises slowly from behind the scenery, lighting the scene from below.
canvasEffects.use: Arriving somewhere, a new day in space, look at the planet! Builds slowly, so cue it a beat early.
